data.name: Qadri
data.gender_notes: Qadri is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qadri is derived from the Arabic word 'qadr', meaning power, capability, or ability. It signifies someone who is powerful or capable. The name Qadri carries the meaning “Powerful, Capable, Able” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qadri usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, capable, able and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name is related to the concept of 'Qadr' in Islam, which refers to the Night of Power or Decree, a significant night in Ramadan mentioned in the Quran.
data.etymology: Qadri belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Capable, Able.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qadri total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: قادري
in_arabic.meaning: القادرية تعني القوة والقدرة على فعل الشيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم قادري مشتق من الجذر العربي ق-د-ر، ويعني القدرة على فعل الشيء، والقوة على التغلب على الأمور، وقد وردت هذه المعاني في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قوله تعالى: «وَيَقْدَرُ وَأَنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاغِبُونَ» (يس: 47)، ويحمل هذا الاسم في طياته معاني القوة والقدرة والغلبة، مما يجعله من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: قادری
in_urdu.meaning: قادری کا مطلب ہوتا ہے طاقت اور کسی چیز کو کرنے کی صلاحیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: قادری نام عربی جڑ ق-د-ر سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز کو کرنے کی طاقت اور صلاحیت، یہ نام اردو بولنے والے مسلمانوں میں خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیا میں بہت مقبول ہے، کیونکہ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے، اور اس کے معنی ہیں طاقت، قوت، اور غلبہ.

in_hindi.name: कादरी
in_hindi.meaning: कादरी का अर्थ है शक्ति और किसी चीज़ को करने की क्षमता
in_hindi.long_meaning: कादरी नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية जड़ ق-د-ر से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति और किसी चीज़ को करने की क्षमता, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, और यह शक्ति, बल और प्रभुत्व के अर्थों को अपने आप में समेटे हुए है, जो इसे इस्लामी परंपरा में एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम बनाता है.

in_pashto.name: قادري
in_pashto.meaning: قادري معنی یې د قدرت او د کوم شی د کولو وړتیا
in_pashto.long_meaning: قادري نوم د عربي ريښو ق-د-ر څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د قدرت او د کوم شی د کولو وړتیا ده، دا نوم د پښتنو او افغانانو په کلتور کې مهم ځای لري، او د قوت، قدرت او غلبې معانی په ځان کې لري.

in_english.name: Qadri
in_english.meaning: Qadri means power and ability to do something
in_english.long_meaning: The name Qadri is derived from the Arabic root ق-د-ر (q-d-r), which means power, ability, and capability. This name is significant in Islamic tradition as it reflects the attributes of Allah, Al-Qadir, the All-Powerful. The name Qadri has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing strength, capability, and divine power. It is mentioned in the Quran in several verses, emphasizing the concept of divine power and ability.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic tradition, Qadri is the name of a Sufi order, known as the Qadriyya. This order emphasizes the importance of knowledge, wisdom, and spiritual practices, especially self-discipline and self-transformation. The Qadriyya order traces its origins to Imam AL-Ghazali, an influential theologian and philosopher. The name Qadri is thus associated with Sufism and the spiritual journey to attain closeness to God.
data.spiritual_significance: For Muslims, the name Qadri holds spiritual relevance as a reminder of the infinite power and ability of God Almighty. The name is a reminder that humans possess a limited power and ability compared to God, and that true strength and capability come from a deep connection to Him. Qadri is a name that inspires seekers to strive for a closer relationship with Allah, trusting in His infinite power and wisdom.
